title: Worlds Marked by Impact
dek: Six surfaces show how impacts persist, erode and become difficult to recognize.
learningObjective: Compare impact signatures across rock, ice, lighting conditions and later surface change.

steps.chapter: A crater that resembles a nebula
steps.prompt: Which radial features reveal an impact rather than a cloud?
How have fill, erosion and wind rewritten the crater floor?
Which bright and dark textures belong to seasonal change?

steps.chapter: A basin larger than the frame
steps.prompt: What lets you read an impact when its full circle is not visible?
Which long ridge preserves the geometry of the impact?
Why does a mapped color swath make this scar easier to study?
